text: بدأت المباراة لصالح Harbour City بهدفين مبكرين سجلهما Elias Okafor وMarek Barros، الذي كان لاعب اللقاء برصيد 2 تمريرات حاسمة و9 اعتراضات على الكرة [#905] [#975]. لكن Seabrook Town استغل تكتيكات أبلغ زيادة في الضغط واللعب المباشر ليبدأوا العودة القوية [#1361]. سجل Tariq Marlowe وCallum Varga أهدافًا سريعة من هجمات مرتدة سريعة بعد الاستحواذ والتسجيل السريع [#1104] [#1448]. وفي الوقت بدل الضائع، تألق Kian Romano بهدفين متتاليين، الأول فرصة متوقعة بنسبة 55% والآخر فرصة مؤكدة بنسبة 99%، ليقلب النتيجة لصالح فريقه 4-2 [#1882] [#1906]. Seabrook Town سيطروا على الكرة أكثر وأطلقوا ضربات أكثر على المرمى، مما يعكس قوة هجومية رائعة رغم البداية المتأخرة. في المقابل، طريقة لعب Harbour City الصبورة لم تنجح عند الحاجة للرد السريع، بينما استغل أصحاب الأرض تكتيكاتهم المتغيرة بالنجاح لتحقيق الفوز الذي يستحقونه.

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in ar

- Seabrook Town’s comeback and eventual win was driven by tactical adaptability reflecting their 3-4-3 formation and wide crossing style. They increased pressing intensity (press rose from 0.66 to 0.84), directness (0.42 to 0.57), and line height (0.6 to 0.72) around the 65th minute to press higher and play more direct when chasing the game, facilitating quicker ball recovery and forward transitions [#1361].

- The goals by Seabrook Town frequently originated from regains and quick direct attacking sequences, such as Tariq Marlowe scoring from a regain with no passes involved, indicating effective counter-attacking within the 3-4-3 framework that exploits wide spaces and rapid breaks [#1104]. Callum Varga’s goal at 69’ also followed a regain and quick buildup with only 3 passes over 16.1 seconds, showing efficient exploitation of turnover moments [#1448].

- Harbour City, playing a 4-2-3-1 focusing on patient short passing, built up their first goal with an extended sequence of 17 passes over 57 seconds, highlighting their deliberate possession style aiming for controlled penetration rather than quick transitions [#905]. Marek Barros’ goal just after halftime came from a rare direct low-xG cross off a corner, showing some variation but mainly reflecting set piece utilization for scoring [#975].

- The late goals by Seabrook Town, including Kian Romano’s brace in stoppage time, featured quick counter-attacks and short passing sequences starting from regains or open play, consistent with the team’s switch to more direct, higher pressing tactics as well as their 3-4-3 wide attacking formation exploiting space behind Harbour City’s higher defensive line [#1882, #1906]. 

- Harbour City’s tactical shift very late in the game to press higher and increase directness came too late to stem the tide; this is evident in the deterioration of their field tilt and increase in opponent xG immediately following their change [#1884]. Their 4-2-3-1 patient build style was less effective once behind and forced into chasing the game.

- Seabrook Town won 4-2 against Harbour City despite trailing 2-0 early in the match [#905, #975, #1104].
- Marek Barros scored for Harbour City with an xg of 0.029 and had 2 assists, 5 key passes, 9 interceptions, and 4 tackles, earning Player of the Match [#975].
- Seabrook Town had a significantly higher xg of 3.53 compared to Harbour City's 1.26, reflecting their dominance in shots (22 vs 10) and chances (3 big chances vs 1) [overall stats].
- Kian Romano scored twice in stoppage time, with very high xg values of 0.554 and 0.994, to complete Seabrook Town's comeback [#1882, #1906].
- Seabrook Town intensified press and direct play tactics from the 65th minute, contributing to their second-half dominance and comeback [#1361].
